summary: Line Describing a Cone is a 1973 film by artist Anthony McCall, made as part of his "solid light" film series. The note says McCall reduced film to the essential properties of the medium, a approach that resembles other radical artists of the period. It also notes the work has inspired projects by Stan Douglas, Richard Serra, and Gordon Matta-Clark.
one_line: A 1973 Anthony McCall film from his "solid light" series that strips film down to the medium's essential properties.
